issues.on_page: Only Schedule 1 (budget and actual, unaudited; report p16 of 21) is in the trimmed PDF
issues.issue: Manifest flags no_statements_found. The 21-page audit almost certainly holds the basic statements (net position / fund balance sheet and the fund revenue/expenditure statement), but the trimmer missed them. The balance sheet and basic-statement lines can't be checked until the PDF is re-trimmed.

issues.on_page: (Budgetary Basis); Fund balances at beginning/end of year
issues.issue: Basis is assumed. The schedule prints budgetary-basis fund balances, and comparable Douglas County SID audits are GAAP (modified accrual). If this one is GAAP too, 5,220,465 / 4,604,269 belong in beginning_fund_balance / ending_fund_balance.
The amount matches the printed 'Fund balances at beginning of year', but it is marked computed even though it is printed as-is. Same for ending_cash 4,604,269.

issues.on_page: Collection fees on property taxes - County Treasurer (26,779)
issues.issue: Netting the fee against property tax is defensible because it is printed within revenues. It could also be treated as a treasurer-fee expense.
This is interest on assessments, not principal. 'special assessments' is defensible and consistent with the other SID reports, but some coders would use investment income.

issues.on_page: Debt service - warrant principal and interest 11,004,039
issues.issue: Combined principal and interest is put entirely in principal; the page gives no split. Same for disbursements[3] (bond principal and interest 1,779,018).
